## Summary

- What changed?
- Why was this change needed?

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test -- --runInBand`

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept route files focused on route-level glue where practical.
- [ ] I updated docs if I changed routing, repo structure, or contributor workflow.
- [ ] If I changed role-based routing or portal behavior, I checked the mounted portal registry, route entry behavior, and navigation/menu logic together.
- [ ] I verified whether the touched flow is API-backed, hybrid, or mock-backed before changing it.
- [ ] I did not add generated artifacts, backups, or diagnostics to active runtime paths.
